verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's own docs show event-triggered webhooks: you subscribe to events such as backup.succeeded and backup.failed, and an authenticated HTTP callback fires automatically when they occur. That is a basic event-to-action mechanism, but there is no documented rule engine with conditions or a choice of actions. The recurring agent schedule and the scheduled backups are time-based, not event-triggered, so they don't count for this story. missing for 10: user-defined rules with conditions, configurable in-product actions beyond webhook notification, a documented catalog of trigger events, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: We've added backup.succeeded and backup.failed webhook events. You'll get notified when a backup finishes, whether it worked or not.
You can now set an Authorization header on webhooks.
